INSERT INTO gcal_meeting_runs (
  gcal_event_id,
  event_summary,
  slack_post_status,
  slack_error,
  oauth_refresh_attempted,
  oauth_refresh_status,
  oauth_error,
  processed_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.gcal_event_id }}',
  '{{ $json.event_summary }}',
  '{{ $json.slack_post_status }}',
  NULL,
  TRUE,
  '{{ $json.oauth_refresh_status }}',
  '{{ $json.oauth_error }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (gcal_event_id) DO UPDATE SET
  slack_post_status = EXCLUDED.slack_post_status,
  oauth_refresh_status = EXCLUDED.oauth_refresh_status,
  oauth_error = EXCLUDED.oauth_error,
  processed_at = EXCLUDED.processed_at;
